hypothesis: Hybrid lexical+exact retrieval beats lexical alone on relevant-case recall@3 without raising lookalike selection (same cases, same access filters, same assessor and question settings).

variants.description: BM25 + exact id + local trigram, reciprocal rank fusion

config.lookalikeDefinition: top-1 candidate case maps to an incident outside key.relatedIncidentKeys, over problems tagged lookalike-different-cause (per-problem table in scoring.ts)
config.recallNote: @N.linking.recall counts related incidents the requester may not see as misses for every variant; @N.accessible.* excludes them

acceptanceCriteria: hybrid recall@3 >= lexical recall@3 AND hybrid lookalike-top-1 rate <= lexical -> ship hybrid; else lexical (EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md E02, applied to validation)
